title: Nonconformance summary
purpose: Count the nonconformances raised in each of the last twelve months by source, and over the same months by area.
summary: How many nonconformances were raised each month and where they came from, for the last twelve months, with the same records counted by area.

tasks.title: See where problems came from this year
steps: Read the [[By month and source]] table. Each row is a month, newest first, and each column a source.
The [[Twelve months]] row adds up each source. Select a total to open those records in the Nonconformances list.

tasks.title: See which areas raise the most records
steps: Read the [[By area]] table. Areas are listed with the most records first.

good_to_know: A record counts in the month it was raised, in the laboratory's time zone, whatever its status now. Closed records still count.
Areas are typed on each record. Spellings that differ only in capitals or spaces count together.
The page shows counts only. It sets no target and makes no judgement about them.
A total opens the list with Show set to All, so it may include records raised before these twelve months.

sections.title: Access
paragraphs: This page exists only while the optional nonconformance module is on; otherwise it answers Not found. Every staff role can open it. It is the Summary tab next to Nonconformances and Corrective actions, under Quality in the sidebar.

items.label: By month and source
items.description: One row for each of the last twelve calendar months, the current month first, and one column for each source: Complaint, Found internally, Audit finding, Proficiency testing, Equipment, External assessment, Preventive action or improvement and Other. Total adds up the row. A month without records shows zeros.

items.label: Twelve months
items.description: The last row adds up each source over the twelve months. A total above zero opens the Nonconformances list showing all records from that source.

items.label: By area
items.description: The records raised in the same twelve months, counted by their area or section, most first. Records without an area are counted as No area recorded.

items.label: Empty state
items.description: No nonconformances in the last twelve months when none was raised in that period.
